title: Clearing of ribosome collisions by the ribosome quality control trigger complex RQT
authors: Best K; Ikeuchi K; Kater L; Best D; Musial J; Matsuo Y; Berninghausen O; Becker T; Inada T; Beckmann R
one_liner_zh: 该文研究核糖体碰撞清除机制，聚焦核糖体解离而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
After translational stalls, colliding eukaryotic ribosomes are cleared through dissociation into subunits by the ribosome quality control trigger complex, RQT, by an unknown mechanism. Here we show that RQT requires accessible mRNA and the presence of a neighboring ribosome. Cryo-EM of several RQT-ribosome complexes revealed the structural basis of splitting: RQT engages the 40S subunit of the lead ribosome and can switch between two conformations. We propose a mechanistic model in which the Slh1 helicase subunit of RQT applies a pulling force on the mRNA, causing destabilizing conformational changes of the 40S subunit. The collided ribosome functions as a ram or giant wedge, ultimately resulting in subunit dissociation. Our findings provide a first conceptual framework for a helicase driven ribosomal splitting mechanism.

One-Sentence Summary

RQT clears collided ribosomes by pulling mRNA to trigger destabilizing conformational transitions for subunit dissociation.
abstract_zh:
在翻译停滞之后，碰撞的真核核糖体通过核糖体质量控制触发复合物RQT解离成亚基而被清除，其机制尚不明确。在此，我们展示了RQT需要可及的mRNA及邻近核糖体的存在。对多个RQT-核糖体复合物的冷冻电镜分析揭示了其分裂的结构基础：RQT与前导核糖体的40S亚基结合，并能在两种构象间切换。我们提出一个机制模型，其中RQT的Slh1解旋酶亚基对mRNA施加拉力，导致40S亚基发生不稳定的构象变化。碰撞的核糖体充当撞锤或巨大楔子，最终促成亚基解离。我们的发现为解旋酶驱动的核糖体分裂机制提供了首个概念框架。

一句话总结

RQT通过拉动mRNA触发不稳定的构象转变，从而清除碰撞核糖体，实现亚基解离。
